routes.retired_because: The conditional polynomial-orbit theorem excludes an obstruction satisfying all exact premises. Independent review remains pending; upstream failure of D:causal-continuation or D:jump is not excluded.

C9000282.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 282 (From scale symmetry to local conformal symmetry in four-dimensional QFT.; papers: Scale and conformal symmetry in four-dimensional operational quantum field theory; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FRAMEWORK.statement: ass:framework: operational Wightman, locality, spectrum, covariance and homogeneous-field assumptions; assumed, not independently established.

C_MAIN.statement: thm:main: physical dimension-two scalar improvement and local conformal symmetry in the original theory.

K_EG_SPLITTING.statement: External finite-order local causal splitting theorem; source read, independent citation attribution pending. It does not imply the fixed-output restriction on its own.

K_TUBE.statement: External Fourier-Laplace cone/tube theorem; source read, independent citation attribution pending.

K_SEMILOCAL.statement: Known failure of the on-shell-amplitude shortcut; not evidence of a nonseparated remainder in this channel.

C_CAUSAL.statement: D:causal-continuation: the common covariant splitting, fixed-virtuality restrictions, uniform finite growth, spectral support, relative sign and common gap. Unreviewed extra manuscript arguments remain.

C_JUMP.statement: D:jump: both horizon jumps have the specified Hilbert-wave formula with the same nonzero normalization.

C_COVARIANT_REMAINDER.statement: Common-order Cauchy subtraction intertwines the z-independent polynomial null-rotation action, forcing polynomial r dependence. Engineer proof gives the conservative bound 2t+2+2e; independent review pending.

C_HILBERT_REGULARIZATION.statement: For every d>=2, the cutoff prescription is H-valued and continuous and its difference from the Cauchy wave is an H-valued transverse polynomial of degree at most 2d+2. Engineer-supported; independent review pending.

C_TWO_HORIZON.statement: D:two-horizon follows conditionally from the common gap, common jump normalization, covariance, wave regularization and output-frame rotation, including the transverse axes. Exact algebra replayed; independent review pending.

C_SUBTRACTIONS.statement: D:subtractions: continuous Hilbert-wave regularizations and uniformly finite separated P_q+P_r ambiguity. Conditional Engineer derivation recorded, not verification of the upstream QFT premises.

C_PREMISE_OBSTRUCTION.statement: A matrix satisfying all precise premises but violating separation is excluded by the conditional Engineer theorem; the refutes judgement is not a refutation of a manuscript assertion. Independent review pending.

C_RADIAL.statement: D:radial-identity after two annular tests remove the separated terms.

C_EXACT_TAIL.statement: D:exact-tail and D:tail-relations from Hankel transfer and inherited spectral comparisons.

C_CRITICAL.statement: D:critical-comparison / D:order-zero: logarithmic pairing and positivity eliminate d_l.

C_CONE_CHARGES.statement: C:single-insertion, C:canonical-Pi, C:Q-zero: local charge forms and zero residual dilation charge.

C_MODULAR.statement: C:cone-modularity and C:time-mobius: actual modular groups and time-Mobius action.

C_RETURN.statement: P:short-products, P:pair-representation and P:return identify l=S.

C_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: R:mixed-products, R:pure-products, R:causal-solution and R:affiliation reconstruct the physical field in the original net.
